quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #8
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: When must you show proof of insurance to police?

options.text: Only if you are in a crash.
If you are in a crash or get stopped for a ticket.
Only if you get stopped and cited.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are in a crash or get stopped for a ticket.
questions.explanation: You must carry proof of insurance when you drive. You must show your insurance proof and license to an officer after a traffic stop or crash.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right.
No right turns allowed.
You can turn right on a red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turns allowed.
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. It is illegal to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: Motorcycles, scooters, and mopeds are hard to see. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down when driving.
Check your mirrors and blind spots often.
Share a lane with a motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots often.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are small and can hide in your blind spot. You must always look for motorcycles, mopeds, and scooters.

questions.question: Why should you use headlights on rainy, snowy, or foggy days?

options.text: To keep your engine warm.
So other drivers can see your vehicle.
To warn others about bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: So other drivers can see your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Bad weather makes it harder for other drivers to see you. Headlights help your vehicle stand out. If you need windshield wipers, you must also turn on your low beam headlights.

questions.question: At a red light with a green arrow, when can you proceed in the direction of the arrow?

options.text: After you come to a complete stop.
When the light changes.
When you are in the correct lane and the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are in the correct lane and the intersection is clear.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in that direction if you are in the right lane. No other signals matter. Yield to pedestrians and vehicles already in the intersection.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Slow down and be careful.
Stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and only go when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be careful.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.
Curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which way to go. You must drive in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows both ways.
The road changes direction ahead.
School zone and crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows both ways.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are leaving a divided road and entering a road where traffic goes both ways.

questions.question: Who must drivers turning left yield to?

options.text: Oncoming vehicles going straight or turning right.
Passing cars.
No one.

questions.correctAnswerText: Oncoming vehicles going straight or turning right.
questions.explanation: A driver turning left must yield to all vehicles coming toward them. This includes bicycles and motorcycles.

questions.question: What is defensive driving?

options.text: Assuming other drivers will do the right thing.
Expecting what other drivers might do and being ready to react.
Expecting no help and giving none.

questions.correctAnswerText: Expecting what other drivers might do and being ready to react.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means watching for mistakes other drivers might make and being prepared to respond safely.

questions.question: You see a flashing red light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down and let other drivers go first.
Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Stop completely, look both ways, and go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, look both ways, and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely, let other traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing, you must:

options.text: Watch for vehicles that must stop at railroad crossings, like school buses and trucks with hazardous materials.
Watch for trains coming from both directions.
Both A and B.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both A and B.
questions.explanation: Approach all railroad crossings with caution. Only cross when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. Also watch for vehicles that must stop at all railroad crossings, such as school buses and trucks carrying hazardous materials.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink and drive.
The road is slippery when wet.
The road curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions just ahead. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop before entering the intersection.
Slow down and proceed carefully.
Wait for a green light before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and look both ways before going. You can proceed carefully if the path is clear.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Information about services for drivers.
Information about road construction and repairs.
Distance information to specific locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Information about services for drivers.
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about driver services. These signs tell you about rest areas, food, hospitals, and other services nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn left here.
You can turn left only after stopping.
All drivers must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn left here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: At a red light with a green arrow, when can you go in the direction of the arrow?

options.text: After you come to a complete stop.
After the light changes to green.
When you are in the correct lane and the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are in the correct lane and the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in that direction if you are in the correct lane and the path is clear. This is true even when the main light is red.

questions.question: When driving through a construction zone, you should:

options.text: Stop to watch the workers.
Drive closer to the car in front of you.
Drive through carefully without slowing down to look at the work.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive through carefully without slowing down to look at the work.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down to look at construction work. This slows traffic and causes congestion. Drive through the zone carefully and keep your eyes on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Curves are ahead.
A divided highway is starting.
The divided highway is ending.

questions.correctAnswerText: The divided highway is ending.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is about to end. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: As you drive faster, what is important to do?

options.text: Turn on your headlights.
Look far ahead of your vehicle.
Change lanes often.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look far ahead of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: At higher speeds, your vehicle needs more distance to stop. Look ahead so you have time to react safely to problems on the road.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
Merge right.
Turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane from the right side.

questions.question: You want to park downhill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Straight ahead
Right, toward the side of the road
Left, toward the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the side of the road
questions.explanation: When parking downhill with no curb, turn your wheels toward the road's edge. This keeps your vehicle from rolling into traffic if your brakes fail. When parking uphill with a curb, turn your wheels toward the center so the car rolls into the curb instead.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you do?

options.text: Rely on the rearview mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.
Rely on the left side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.
questions.explanation: Always look over your shoulder to check for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes. You may need to check several times. Keep watch for traffic both ahead and next to you.

questions.question: The center has one solid yellow line and one broken yellow line next to your lane. What does this mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to pass in this area.
You are in a passing zone and can pass other vehicles on the left if no oncoming traffic is present.
You are only allowed to make right turns in this area.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are in a passing zone and can pass other vehicles on the left if no oncoming traffic is present.
questions.explanation: When there is a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line, you can pass from the side with the broken line if it is safe.

questions.question: You have a green light and there are pedestrians in the intersection. What must you do?

options.text: You must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians.
You have the right-of-way over pedestrians.
Pedestrians must wait for you to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, you must yield to pedestrians and vehicles already in the intersection. Always yield to pedestrians when turning on a steady green signal.

questions.question: If there is a deep puddle ahead on the road, what should you do?

options.text: Maintain the posted speed to get through the water.
Avoid the puddle if possible.
Shift into neutral as you drive through the water.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid the puddle if possible.
questions.explanation: To prevent skidding, avoid slippery areas like ice, wet leaves, oil, and deep puddles. Dry, solid surfaces are safest for driving.

questions.question: If you are driving on a highway next to a single broken white line, what can you do?

options.text: You cannot cross the line to pass.
You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
You may only cross the line to change lanes if you are in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
questions.explanation: White dashed lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You can cross a dashed white line to pass or change lanes if it is safe.

questions.question: If bad weather makes it hard to see, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up to get off the road quickly.
Drive in the lane closest to oncoming traffic.
Increase your following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase your following distance.
questions.explanation: In poor visibility or darkness, increase your distance behind other vehicles. This gives you more time to react to hazards you cannot see in advance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is coming. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Steep grade ahead.
Winding road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep grade ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings indicates a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and prevent brake damage.
